## bluefin-cli brewfile add

Add a package entry (and optionally install it)

```
bluefin-cli brewfile add <name> [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --file string   Brewfile path (default: ~/Brewfile)
  -h, --help          help for add
      --kind string   Entry kind: brew, cask, winget, scoop, choco (default "brew")
```
